title: SoftHateBench: Evaluating Moderation Models Against Reasoning-Driven, Policy-Compliant Hostility

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating and comparing hate speech detection rates (Hate Success Rate) across specific racial and ethnic target groups (e.g., African American, Asian, White) using the SoftHateBench dataset.
Evaluating and comparing hate speech detection rates across specific religious target groups (e.g., Jewish, Muslim, Christian) using the SoftHateBench dataset.
Evaluating and comparing hate speech detection rates across gender identities (e.g., Women, Men, Non-binary, Transgender) using the SoftHateBench dataset.
Evaluating and comparing hate speech detection rates across sexual orientation groups (e.g., Gay/Lesbian) using the SoftHateBench dataset.
Evaluating and comparing hate speech detection rates across nationality and migration status groups (e.g., Migrants, Refugees) using the SoftHateBench dataset.
Evaluating and comparing hate speech detection rates across socioeconomic classes (e.g., Working class, Elite) using the SoftHateBench dataset.
Evaluating and comparing hate speech detection rates across political ideologies (e.g., Left, Right) using the SoftHateBench dataset.
